summit-line.title: Summit Line
howto: Press Drop in and race three rivals 2 km down the mountain to the finish arch.
Carve to steer, tuck for speed, brake to scrub it off.
Hold jump to crouch and release to ollie; the kickers throw you high.
In the air, spin, flip and grab, then land with the board pointing down the hill or you crash.
Tricks score points and fill the boost meter. Burn boost to pass the rivals.
tips: Let go of the spin just before you land: the board settles onto the fall line by itself.
Hold a grab for more than 0.7 s to tweak it for extra points.
Land your next trick within 3.5 s to raise the combo, up to x5. A crash resets it.
Rail points only count once you land cleanly after popping off the rail.
The first kicker, at 90 m, is the gentle one: try your first grab there.
Trees and rocks crash you and cost about two seconds, so pick lines through the open snow.

controls.touch: Left thumb pad steers, tucks and brakes (spins and flips in the air). Hold JUMP and let go to ollie, hold GRAB in the air, tap BOOST to burn the meter.
controls.gamepad: Left stick steers, tucks and brakes; A ollies; X, Y and B grab (Indy, Melon, Method); RB or RT boosts.

high-nest.title: High Nest
howto: A plank swings above your treehouse. Tap to drop it.
Only the part that lands on the stack stays; the overhang is sawn off.
Miss the stack completely and the build is over. Stack as high as you can.
tips: Watch the plank's edges, not the owl: tap when they line up with the plank below.
Four PERFECT drops in a row make your plank 18 px wider.
The swing speeds up with every plank, so the first ten are the time to bank PERFECTs.
The dotted rust line in the sky marks your best height.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter drops the plank (and starts a build). P or Esc pauses. M switches the game's sound.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to drop the plank. The pause tab is top right.

cheats.effect: Planks swing in twice as wide

Big owl mode

high-nest.difficulty: Pick the saw speed on the title card: Easy starts slow, never passes a medium swing and forgives 10 px on a PERFECT; Normal is the classic curve; Hard starts fast and only forgives 5 px. The swing speeds up with every plank, and each setting keeps its own best.

features.results: Results card with planks, height, perfects, best combo and the best for this saw speed, plus NEW BEST

market-merge.title: Market Merge
howto: Aim the fruit above the crate and drop it in.
Two of the same fruit that touch squash into the next size up; quick chains score extra.
Keep everything below the dashed rim: fruit resting above it for a moment closes the stall.
tips: Keep the big fruit in one corner and feed the small ones in beside them.
Check NEXT before you drop so you know where the following fruit will go.
Two watermelons that meet are sold for +200.
Undo takes back your last drop: Easy gives 5 per crate, Normal 3 and Hard 1.

controls.keyboard: Mouse or arrow keys aim; click, Space or Enter drops. U undoes, H shows a hint, P or Esc pauses, M switches the game's sound.
controls.touch: Touch the crate and drag to aim, lift your finger to drop. Undo and Hint sit bottom left; the pause tab is top right.

cheats.effect: The rim never overflows
Slow-motion crate: fruit falls and rolls at half speed
The fruit in your hand becomes a pumpkin
Unlimited undos

market-merge.difficulty: Stall rules on the title card: Easy only drops cherries to apricots, gives 5 undos and a longer grace at the rim; Normal drops up to oranges with 3 undos; Hard drops up to apples with 1 undo and a short grace. Each keeps its own best. The daily crate plays Normal rules.

survivor-wave.title: Survivor Wave
howto: Pick a hero card, then press FIGHT. Your weapons fire on their own.
Move to dodge the horde and pick up the XP gems enemies drop.
Each level up, choose a new weapon, a weapon upgrade or a passive.
A weapon at Lv5 plus its matching passive evolves into an EVO form.
Survive 10 minutes to clear the stage; spend the gold you earn in the Armory.
tips: Keep moving in wide circles: the horde trails behind you, into your weapons.
Dash (Space) gives you a moment of invulnerability: use it to slip out when you are boxed in.
Elites drop chests with free upgrades: hunt them.
The ULT meter fills as you fight: press R when it glows.
Armory upgrades are permanent, so even a short run makes the next one easier.

controls.keyboard: Enter or Space starts from the title. WASD or arrows to move, Space dash, R ultimate, T opens the turret build bar, Q mortar strike, P pause (Esc also pauses in the arcade).
controls.touch: Drag anywhere to move; tap the lightning button to dash and ULT for the ultimate.
controls.gamepad: Left stick to move, A to dash, Start to pause.

surviv-royale.title: Surviv Royale
howto: Sixteen players drop in; you start in the middle with an M9 pistol.
Move, aim and shoot; walk over pick-ups to grab guns, ammo, bandages and medkits.
Shoot crates open for more loot.
Stay inside the circle: the red gas outside it hurts, and the circle closes in through six zones.
Be the last one standing to win.
tips: Swap the M9 early: crates often hold an MP5, M870 or AK-47.
Heal behind cover: a bandage (3) takes 2 s, a medkit (4) takes 4 s.
When a dashed white ring appears, that is the next circle: get inside it before the gas arrives.
Bushes hide you: bots do not spot you in one from far away.
Reload (R) between fights, not in the middle of one.

controls.keyboard: WASD to move, mouse to aim, left button to fire, R reload, 3 bandage, 4 medkit. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag on the left half to move, drag on the right half to aim and fire; RELOAD, BANDAGE and MEDKIT buttons on the right.

hole-grind.title: Hole Grind
hole-grind.why3d: Hole.io is a 3D game: the fun is watching buildings tip into the hole.
howto: Steer the hole around the city and swallow anything smaller than it.
Every bite makes the hole wider, so coins, cones, benches, trees, cars, trucks, houses and towers become food in turn.
A rival hole that grows bigger than you swallows you. When the clock runs out your score is banked as coins for upgrades and new districts.
tips: Watch NEXT in the top-left panel: it says how big you must be to swallow the next kind of prop.
Early on, sweep up coins and cones; they add up fast.
GRAVITY WELL drags nearby food into you, a strong first buy.
Beat a district's quota to clear it; later districts pay up to x3.20 per bite.
Cars and trucks drive along the roads: meet them head on.

controls.keyboard: WASD or the arrow keys steer, or hold the mouse button and the hole rolls toward the pointer. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold a finger on the screen and the hole rolls toward it. The pause button is top right.

balloon-bust.title: Balloon Bust
howto: Pick Math Pop (sums within 20) or Word Pop (first words), and a speed. Tapping the sky starts the highlighted (pink) mode.
The blimp asks a question and answer balloons float up. Tap the balloon with the answer.
Right pops earn stars; a wrong pop just shows a hint. Every 10 stars become a sticker in your sticker book.
tips: Three right pops in a row double your stars, and the combo climbs up to x4.
Missed one? The hint card shows how to count it, or which letter the word starts with.
Balloons that float away come back from the bottom, so take your time.
Chill speed gives little hands more time to aim.

controls.keyboard: Click a balloon, or press 1 to 4 to pop the balloons counted from the left. On the title, 1 picks Math Pop, 2 Word Pop, Enter plays. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap Math Pop or Word Pop (or anywhere on the sky) to start, then tap a balloon. The pause button is top right.

balloon-bust.difficulty: Pick Chill, Normal or Zoom on the title to set how fast the balloons rise. Sums stay within 20 and the words are first-grade words, made for ages 4 to 8. Nothing ever ends a round early.

long-way-home.title: The Long Way Home
howto: Pick Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) or Master (9–11), then a leg: Arithmetic, Ballast Trim, Instrument Check, Signal Repair, Scrambled Beacon or the Long Haul.
Read the question on the paper card at the top.
Steer your ship through the ring with the right answer; a wrong ring costs a hull point and shows the answer with a teaching hint.
In word legs, fly through the letters in order, or type the whole word.
Reach the end of the leg before the hull gives out; three hull points left earns three marks.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the ring in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
Every three right answers in a row raises your multiplier; every five earns a free kit item.
CLEAR removes all but one wrong ring; DRIFT slows time; PATCH mends one hull point.
Every four answers the questions step up inside your age band.
The end card lists every miss with its answer and hint: read it before the next leg.

controls.keyboard: Mouse or arrows steer; 1, 2, 3 use Drift, Clear, Patch; type letters to spell the whole word; H shows a hint in number legs; M toggles sound; Esc, Space (between rings) or P pauses.
controls.touch: Drag to steer; tap DRIFT, CLEAR, PATCH and HINT under the ship; TYPE WORD opens the keyboard in word legs.

long-way-home.difficulty: Three age bands: Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) and Master (9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers and every four answers steps up inside it: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

features.results: End card with marks, log, answers, longest run, accuracy, distance, the missed-question review and the grown-up report

maths-kart.title: Maths Kart GP
howto: Pick your age band, Math or Spelling, and a track, then Play.
Hold accelerate and steer to stay on the road.
Green boost pads put a question at the top and four balloons on the road ahead.
Drive through the balloon with the right answer for a rocket boost; a wrong one spins you out and shows a hint.
In Spelling, drive through the word's letters in order. Finish three laps.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the balloon question: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
A shield item skips your next question; oil slows the other karts for a few seconds.
Each lap the questions step up inside your age band, so the last lap is the hardest.
A wrong balloon costs speed, not the race: read the hint and nail it next time.
Checkpoints count in order: cut across the grass and the lap will not count.

math-miner.title: Math Miner
howto: Pick your age band, then Math Mode or Spelling Mode.
Dig down with the arrows (or the dig pad). Every dig costs energy.
Walk into a rock with a sum carved on it and pick the gem with the right answer (in Spelling, tap the letters in order).
Ride the elevator up (E) to sell your ore, then spend it in the shop.
tips: Stuck on a rock? HINT teaches the step: make a ten, count up on a number line, or the next sound in the word.
A wrong answer hardens the rock for two seconds and costs one energy, so read the hint before trying again.
Go up before your energy hits zero: the winch drags you home and the run ends.
Deeper bands pay more for ore (coal, iron, gold, diamond) but ask harder questions.
A Battery Tank gives more energy per descent; the Elevator Shaft starts you deeper.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or WASD move and dig; type an answer and press Enter, or click a gem; E rides the elevator up; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Dig pad (bottom right) moves and digs; tap a gem to answer; ELEVATOR UP and HINT sit in the top bar.

word-dungeon.title: Word Dungeon
howto: Pick your age band, then Math or Spelling.
Run right, jump over spikes and stomp slimes from above.
Locked chests and doors ask a question: jump on the floor runes in order to spell the answer.
Take the key from the rune door and walk into the EXIT to go one level deeper.
tips: A wrong rune pops spikes and costs a heart, but the hint that appears teaches the step: read it before you jump again.
Stuck on a lock? The free hint (/ key or the ? button) gives a number-line or next-sound nudge; a hint scroll lights the next rune.
Every fourth depth the Slime King asks three quick questions, so buy a heart in the shop first.
Jump twice for a double jump: you need it for the twin towers.
Coins buy hearts (12) and hint scrolls (6) between depths.

fishing-for-words.title: Fishing for Words
howto: Pick your age band, then Play: Spelling or Play: Maths.
Tap (or Space) to start the power meter, tap again to cast.
When a fish bites, tap as the gold ring meets the green circle.
Keep the fish only if it is the next letter of the clue word (or weighs the answer to the sum); release the rest.
Meet the day's quota before your casts run out, then spend your coins on better gear.
tips: HINT teaches the next step: the first letter and length of the word, the next sound, or a number-line nudge for the sum.
Keeping a wrong fish muddies the bucket and costs 2 coins; releasing it is free.
A better rod widens the strike window; a better lure brings silver and golden fish.
Golden fish are worth five times as much and go on your trophy shelf.
Every two days the words and sums step up inside your age band.

controls.touch: Tap anywhere to charge, cast and strike; KEEP and RELEASE buttons appear when a fish is hooked; HINT sits bottom right.

quiz-tower.title: Quiz Tower Defense
howto: Pick your age band, a mode (Math or Spelling) and a map, then Defend the Castle.
Choose a tower on the right (Arrow, Cannon or Frost) and tap a grass square beside the path.
Press START to send a wave; answer the Command Panel question at the bottom.
A right answer OVERCHARGES every tower; a wrong one makes them sputter and shows a hint.
Survive ten waves to win up to three stars.
tips: HINT (H) teaches the step for the question in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or read the sentence with each word in the gap.
When a purple Quiz Golem marches, arm the pedestal (A to D) that matches the right answer to double its loot.
Frost towers slow runners, cannons splash groups at the bends, arrows are cheap and fast.
Tap a tower to upgrade it or sell it for 60% back.
A Focus Token from the armory turns one wrong answer into an overcharge.

controls.touch: Tap a tower card, then a grass square; tap an answer; HINT sits bottom right. Hold the phone sideways (upright play is optional).

quiz-tower.difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers, and the questions step up inside that range as the waves go on (every three waves in Math, every two in Spelling); enemies grow tougher each wave.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the menu; waves ramp the tier inside the band

features.results: Victory screen with 1 to 3 stars, or Game Over, with waves survived, kills, career record and this game's accuracy

mini-mart.title: QuickStop Mini Mart
howto: Press Play to open the day. The bar at the top shows the clock and the day's takings target.
Tap Add to Cart on products (or Scan barcodes), then open the cart and Proceed to Checkout.
Checked-out sales count toward the target. Beat it before the clock hits 0:00 to clear the day.
At close, the day's costs come out of your takings. Spend the store bank on upgrades in Career.
tips: Pricier lines like Salmon Fillet ($12.99) fill the target fastest, but only a few are in stock.
Only checked-out sales count: don't leave a full cart when the clock runs out.
Scans within five seconds of each other build a streak.
Miss three targets in a row and the store goes into arrears: the target rises 15% until you clear a day.
Express Register adds 30 seconds to every day; Standing Restock refills every shelf at opening.

controls.keyboard: Tab to any button and press Enter. Ctrl+K jumps to search; type a barcode in Scan and press Enter. Esc closes a panel, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap Add to Cart, the cart icon and the buttons. Scroll the page to see more shelves.

cheats.effect: +$500 in the store bank
Every product line refilled to double its opening stock
+60 seconds on the day clock, today and every day while codes are on
Every bonus product line unlocked

mini-mart.difficulty: Easy, Normal or Hard on the title card, between days. Easy days last 2:30 with targets 20% lower; Hard days last 1:30 with targets 20% higher. Targets and daily costs rise every day you clear.

features.goals-or-day-targets: Each day has a takings target and a countdown clock in the day bar; targets rise with every day cleared

field-station.title: Field Station
howto: Pick your year group, then open an instrument card (or press Play for the one you have done least).
Each instrument gives you a brief: build the circuit, balance the equation, place the comma, build the word.
Check your work. Every answer, right or wrong, explains why, and lands in your skill map.
Finish an instrument's briefs to certify it. Stuck? Hint in the pause menu reads your current question.
tips: In Circuit Bay, series bulbs share one path and glow dim; parallel bulbs each get their own branch.
In Reaction Bench, change only the big numbers in front of a formula, never the small ones inside it.
In Signal Room, break a new word at its seams and read the meaning of each part in order.
In Log Office, read the sentence aloud both ways before you choose where the comma goes.
Mistakes lower a skill faster than right answers raise it, so a steady run beats lucky guesses.

controls.keyboard: Tab to any card, chip or button and press Enter; arrow keys move the Particle Chamber sliders. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap cards, parts and buttons; drag the sliders; tap gaps on the circuit board to place parts.

field-station.difficulty: Year-group bands (Y5–6, Y7–8, Y9, or all) choose which instruments show, and each instrument's briefs step up from one bulb or one word to multi-part problems. Mastery drops faster for a mistake than it rises for a right answer.

features.age-or-level-bands: Year group chips on the station (All years, Y5–6, Y7–8, Y9) filter the instruments by their year range; the choice is remembered
features.hints: Hint in the pause menu reads the live question: the next word part by meaning, the uneven element and a coefficient to try, the gap that needs a mark, the clause type to add, the circuit diagnosis, the chamber state to reach, or the food-web links to follow
features.grown-up-progress-report: Report for grown-ups (on the station): accuracy, streak, each instrument's level and each skill's mastery, with a Print button
features.results: Each instrument ends with its own results panel (for example Transmission decoded: 9 of 16 correct) with Run it again and Back to station
features.tutorial: Three coach marks on the first visit: the instruments, the year group and the progress report; replay from How it works

bloxburg-town.title: Bloxburg Town
howto: Press Play once the town has loaded.
Move with WASD, look with the mouse, hold Shift to run, and press E to use things.
Claim a brown plot with E, then build (B), furnish (F) and paint (C) your house.
Work at the blue shop for cash; check the mailbox every day for a gift.
tips: Claim a plot first: building needs a plot of your own.
Every shift at a job promotes you, and higher levels pay more.
The mailbox gift grows with your daily streak, so come back every day.
A gem appears around town each day: find it for a cash reward.
Esc closes the build, furniture and shop panels.

controls.keyboard: WASD move, mouse look, Shift run, Space jump, E interact, B build, F furniture, C paint, J journal, P photo mode, Esc closes panels
controls.touch: Best on a desktop browser: the town needs a keyboard; on a phone you can tap Play, the tutorial and the pause button

cheats.effect: Hunger filled right up
Energy filled right up
Fun filled right up

bloxburg-town.difficulty: No difficulty modes: it is a relaxed sandbox where jobs pay more as you are promoted and the daily mailbox gift grows with your streak.

features.autosave: The town saves itself when you buy, claim or collect, and on quit; the save is kept in IndexedDB
features.goals-or-quests: The tutorial's steps (claim a plot, build, work, mailbox) and the daily gem and mailbox streak
features.day-time-ui: Clock and day in the HUD with a day/night cycle
features.inventory: Furniture bought at the shop kiosk waits in your inventory until you place it in furniture mode (F); J opens the journal
features.results: No game over: a sandbox; the HUD shows money and needs

bridge-rush.title: Bridge Rush
bridge-rush.why3d: Bridge Race is a 3D stair-building race.
howto: You run on your own toward the finish flag, racing a rival builder on the next span.
Snatch the floating planks: each one is material.
At a gap, hold (or Down) to lay planks across it; tap (or Space) hops the orange cones.
Run out of planks at a gap and you fall. Reach the flag first for the big bonus.
tips: Every gap auto-builds slowly; holding builds faster and saves your lead.
Cones knock 1 to 3 planks loose, so hop them even when you are in a hurry.
Keep a few planks spare before each wide gap: later legs have longer gaps and less ground.
Finishing first is worth 500 points, second 200: the rival matters more than distance.

controls.keyboard: Space, W or Up to hop; hold S, Down or J to build; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap to hop; press and hold at a gap to build; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: Planks cost nothing: every gap bridges itself
The rival builder works at three-quarter speed
Cones cost no material and never trip you

bridge-rush.difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 10 to 22 over the first 520 m, gaps widen from 3 to 6 planks, the ground between them shrinks, and cones cost up to 3 planks in the later legs.

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start

features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD (starred when you pass it)
features.tutorial-card: A skippable coach card at the first gap on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Results screen with placing, score, distance, planks, gaps and all-time best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio and soft shadows; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the island scenery.

crowd-clash.title: Crowd Clash
crowd-clash.why3d: Crowd runners (Count Masters) are 3D tracks seen from behind.
howto: Your crowd runs forward on its own. Steer left and right.
Run through the green half of each gate (x2, +10) to grow the crowd; the red half shrinks it.
Dodge the swinging maces and bars, and keep off the gate's centre post.
Reach the boss gate with 45 or more runners to burst it and win.
tips: A x2 gate early is worth more than a +10 gate late.
The centre post of every gate costs 3 runners: commit to one side.
A bar knocks out 6 and a mace 5, so dodging beats gambling on a bad gate.
A single bad gate can never wipe you out: it always leaves at least one runner.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right or A / D to steer; Space or Enter starts; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag left and right to steer; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: Your crowd jumps by 40 runners (and every run starts with 48)
Maces, bars and gate posts knock nobody out
The track runs at 60% speed

crowd-clash.difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 12.5 to 24 on the way to the boss gate at 920 m, and gates and hazards come closer together (gates every 32 m at the start, every 19 m near the end).

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start
features.instant-restart: Run again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu

features.results: Gate burst / Crowd wiped out screen with peak crowd, distance, gates, score and best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio, soft shadows from every runner; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the roadside scenery.

helix-drop.title: Helix Drop
helix-drop.why3d: Helix Jump is a 3D tower you rotate.
howto: The ball bounces on its own. Spin the tower so it drops through the gaps.
Drag sideways, or hold Left / Right (A / D), to rotate the rings.
Never let the ball land on a red block. Gold blocks are bonuses.
Drop as deep as you can; every 8 rings is a new level.
tips: Threading several gaps in a row builds a combo.
A near miss past a red block slows time for a moment: use it to line up the next gap.
Short taps nudge the tower; hold only for long turns.
The fall gets faster as you go deeper, so start turning before the ball lands.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right or A / D to spin; Space or Enter starts; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag left and right to spin; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: Red rings bounce you instead of ending the run
The ball falls at 60% gravity
The ball drops straight through every ring

helix-drop.difficulty: An adaptive curve: every ring deeper adds spin speed (12 up to 20 blocks a second) and gravity (up to 2.3x); red blocks start on ring 4 and one more appears every 4 rings, and past ring 16 many gaps shrink to a single block.

features.one-tap-start: Start the drop on the title, a tap on the tower, or Space
features.instant-restart: Drop again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best depth on the title card and a Best cell in the HUD
features.tutorial-card: A skippable 'Spin the tower' coach card on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Red ring screen with depth, level, bonuses, best combo and all-time best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High renders the 3D tower at up to 2x pixel ratio with soft real-time shadows; Low renders at 1x with no shadow pass.

rung-runner.title: Rung Runner
howto: You run forward on your own down three lanes.
Tap left or right (or the arrow keys) to change lanes and grab the gold rungs.
A wall needs as many rungs as the number on it: with enough in hand you climb over it.
Saw blades end the run: change lanes to dodge them.
tips: Count ahead: the number on the next wall is how many rungs you need.
Rungs you spend on a wall are gone, so keep collecting after every climb.
The middle lane lets you dodge a saw either way.
The road speeds up every zone, so change lanes earlier the further you get.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right or A / D to change lanes; Space starts; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap the left or right half, or swipe, to change lanes; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: 20 rungs in hand now, and every run starts with 20
Saw blades pass straight through you
The road runs at 60% speed

rung-runner.difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 14.5 to 31 over the first 950 m through five zones, and walls grow from about 2 rungs to 6 (higher still when you hoard rungs).

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio and soft shadows; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the floating islands.

snake-clash.title: Snake Clash
howto: Your snake always moves: steer it with the mouse, a finger or Left / Right.
Eat the glowing orbs to grow longer.
Cut across a rival so its head hits your body: it bursts into orbs for you.
Touch a rival's body or the wall and you burst instead.
tips: Grow before you fight: a longer snake wins head-on meetings.
Boost (Shift or Space) to cut a rival off, but it burns length.
Burst rivals leave a trail of orbs: sweep it straight away.
More rivals join as you grow, so keep away from the arena edge when it gets busy.

controls.keyboard: Mouse to aim, or Left / Right (A / D) to turn; hold Shift or Space to boost; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag to steer; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: Boost burns no length
Grow by 40 segments right now
Slide through rival snakes; only the wall can burst you

snake-clash.difficulty: An adaptive curve: you start against 3 rivals, one more joins for every 7 segments you grow (up to 9), and they speed up as you get longer.

features.instant-restart: Play again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best length on the title card
features.tutorial-card: Two skippable coach cards on the first run (steer, then boost); Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Burst! screen with length, score, orbs, rivals burst, time and best length

volt-dash.title: Volt Dash
howto: You run on your own. Your battery drains every second.
Tap (or Space) to hop the pink zapper spikes; swipe down (or hold Down) to slide under the orange conduits.
Grab the green battery cells: each one is +12 volts. At zero volts the lights go out.
tips: A hit costs 26 volts, two whole cells: dodging matters more than collecting.
Dash (Shift or swipe right) costs 22 volts but smashes straight through a hazard.
Cells float at three heights: hop early to catch the high ones.
Every sector the run gets faster and the drain gets stronger, so bank cells early.

controls.keyboard: Space, W or Up to hop; S or Down to slide; Shift or X to dash; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap to hop, swipe down to slide, swipe right to dash; the pause button sits bottom right

cheats.effect: Battery never drains and hits cost nothing
The grid runs at 60% speed
Battery cells fly to you from any height

volt-dash.difficulty: An adaptive curve: speed climbs from 11 to 24 and the battery drain from 4 to 15 volts a second over the first 900 m, through five sectors.

hub-flappy-flight.title: Flappy Flight
howto: Press Play: the bird hovers until your first tap.
Tap, click or press Space to flap. Each flap lifts the bird.
Fly through the gaps between the pipes. Each pipe is 1 point, a star 2, a feather 3.
tips: Short, steady taps beat big panicky ones.
A feather gives you a shield that saves you from one crash.
Three close shaves in a row also earn a shield.
The pipes speed up as your score climbs, up to about 30 points.
Sprint mode ends after 20 pipes and pays a bonus for every close shave.

Wide gaps: every pipe gap is 40% taller
Slow motion: the whole sky runs at 60% speed

hub-dino-dash.title: Dino Dash
howto: Press Play: the dino jogs on the spot until your first jump.
Tap or press Space to jump; tap again in the air for a double jump.
Swipe down or press the Down arrow to duck under low birds.
Run as far as you can: distance is your score.
tips: High birds fly over your head: just keep running.
A feather gives you a shield that takes one hit.
The magnet pulls bones to you and each one counts double while it lasts.
Clear a cactus by a whisker for a +10 close bonus.
Every 500 m earns a medal; the sky turns to night every 400 m.

cheats.effect: Iron hide: cacti and birds bounce off you

hub-color-switch.title: Color Switch
howto: Press Play: the ball waits at the top of the circle until your first tap.
Tap or press Space to spin the ball round the circle; it slows down on its own.
When a ring closes in, be on the segment that matches your ball's colour.
Your colour changes after every ring. A wrong colour costs a heart.
tips: Taps stack: two quick taps spin the ball about twice as far.
Passing through the middle of a segment keeps a Bullseye streak going.
Hearts come back at 10, 25 and 40 rings.
Gold rings are worth 2 extra points.
Chaos mode flickers your colour every second: watch the ball, not the ring.

hub-brick-breaker.title: Brick Breaker
howto: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard, then press Play.
Drag anywhere, or use the arrow keys, to move the paddle.
Tap or press Space to launch the ball, and keep it bouncing into the bricks.
Clear every brick to reach the next level. Lose every ball and the run ends.

Bricks with a white chevron take two hits (three on the top row from level 6).
Breaking bricks without touching the paddle builds a combo worth extra points.
A shield power-up saves one ball that would have been lost.
Catch Slow ball when things get hectic: the ball moves at 62% speed for 8 seconds.

Multi-ball: every serve launches three balls

hub-memory-match.title: Memory Match
howto: Pick Easy (6 pairs), Normal (8) or Hard (10) and press Play.
Tap a card to flip it, then tap a second card.
Two matching cards stay face up; two different cards flip back.
Find every pair in as few moves as you can: fewer moves earn more stars.

Three matches in a row earn a Peek, which shows every card for a moment.
A game with no misses is Flawless and adds a bonus star to your bank.
Shuffle mode reshuffles the face-down cards after every miss: pure short-term memory.
Hint only uses cards you have already seen.

Auto pair: one pair matches itself (enter it again for more)

hub-sudoku.title: Sudoku
howto: Pick Easy, Medium, Hard or the Daily puzzle and press Play.
Tap an empty square, then tap a number (or type 1 to 9).
Every row, every column and every 3x3 box must hold 1 to 9 exactly once.
Yellow numbers are given; a red number is a mistake.
tips: Look for a square whose row, column and box already hold eight different numbers.
Pick a number and scan: if it can only go in one square of a row, it goes there.
Turn on notes (the pencil) to jot down every candidate in a hard square.
Hint names the next move that logic proves, and why; tap it again to fill that square.
Undo takes back a number, a note or an erase, but a mistake still counts.

Fill box: one unfinished 3x3 box fills itself
Freeze time: the clock stops

features.hints: The bulb button: explains the next logically forced square (a naked or hidden single), points at it, and fills it on a second tap; also in Pause > Hint
features.undo: The undo button (or Z) takes back numbers, notes and erases
features.level-select-or-daily: Easy, Medium and Hard on the title, plus a Daily puzzle that is the same for everyone each day
features.results: Solved card with mistakes, time, best time, streak, hints used, badges, rank and daily streak

hub-block-blast.title: Block Blast
howto: Choose Classic or the Daily blocks and press Play.
Tap one of the three blocks under the grid to pick it up.
Tap the grid: the block lands with its top-left corner on that square.
Fill a whole row or column to blast it. The game ends when none of your blocks fits.
tips: Blocks never rotate, so keep room for long bars and the big L.
Clearing lines on back-to-back moves builds a combo that multiplies the points.
Every clear charges the Blast meter; at 5 you get a bomb that wipes a 3x3 area.
Hint tries every block in every spot and shows a ghost where the best one goes.
Undo takes back your last drop, as often as you like.

controls.keyboard: 1, 2 or 3 picks a block, arrow keys move it, Enter drops it, Z undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a block, then tap the grid. Undo, Hint and New Game sit under the tray.

cheats.effect: Bomb squad: a bomb joins your tray right now
Tiny blocks: every new block is 3 squares or fewer
Fresh tray: swap your blocks for three new ones

hub-block-blast.difficulty: An adaptive curve: the first eight blocks are small, blocks get smaller again when the grid is crowded, and a new tray is re-rolled toward small pieces when nothing would fit.

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): tries every block in every spot, picks the drop that clears most and leaves the fewest gaps, and shows it as a ghost on the grid
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back the last drop, any number of times
features.level-select-or-daily: Daily blocks on the title: everyone gets the same blocks in the same order today, with its own daily best
features.results: The grid shows GAME OVER with the run's points, clears and best combo in a card, and the score board updates

hub-minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
howto: Pick Easy (8 mines), Normal (10), Hard (16) or the Daily board, then press Play.
Tap a square to open it. Your first tap is always safe.
A number tells you how many mines touch that square, diagonals included.
Hold a square (or right-click) to flag a mine. Open every safe square to win.
tips: A 1 with only one hidden neighbour: that neighbour is a mine.
When a number already has all its mines flagged, tap it to open the rest around it.
Compare two numbers side by side: the difference often proves a square safe.
Hint only uses the numbers and flags on the board, and names the square it proves.
Took a mine? Take back that move: the game goes on, but it will not count for your records.

controls.keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys pick a square, Enter opens it, F flags it. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap to open, hold to flag (or turn on Flag mode). Tap a number to open around it.

cheats.effect: Safe path: five safe squares open for you
Mine radar: hidden mines show faintly
Extra life: the next mine you tap is flagged instead

hub-minesweeper.difficulty: Easy has 8 mines, Normal 10 and Hard 16 on the 9x9 board. The Daily board has 12 mines, is the same for everyone today and starts already opened.

features.hints: Hint button (and Pause > Hint): proves a safe square or a mine from the numbers, says which numbers prove it and makes the square glow; if nothing is certain it names the least risky square
features.undo: Undo button takes back any flag or opening; Take back that move on the Boom card undoes a mine (that game then keeps no record)
features.level-select-or-daily: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title, plus a Daily board that is the same for everyone each day
features.results: Cleared or Boom card with time, best, flag accuracy, stars, rank and achievements

hub-tower-stack.title: Tower Stack
howto: Press Play: a block slides back and forth above the tower.
Tap, click or press Space to drop it.
Only the part that lands on the tower stays, so the blocks get narrower.
Stack as high as you can. Miss the tower completely and the run ends.
tips: Drop when the block's middle crosses the dashed centre line: within 3 px is a PERFECT (+2).
Three PERFECTs in a row widen the block again.
Every 10th block is gold and worth 3 extra points.
Every 12 blocks earns a heart (up to 3); a heart saves one complete miss.
Your best run's tower shows as a faint ghost to beat.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter drops the block. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to drop the block

cheats.effect: Slow motion: the block slides at 55% speed
Magnet: anything within 14 px of centre counts as PERFECT
Full hearts: three hearts, topped up after every save

hub-tower-stack.difficulty: An adaptive curve: the block slides a little faster with every block on the tower, up to nearly twice its starting speed.

features.one-tap-start: Play starts the run; the first tap drops the first block
features.instant-restart: Play Again (or Space) on the results card starts a new tower at once
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the height at the top of the screen, and on the title
features.tutorial-card: First-run card with a tapping finger that stays until your first drop
features.results: Game Over card with height, best and best PERFECT chain

hub-connect-four.title: Connect Four
howto: Pick Pass & Play or a CPU (Easy, Normal or Hard) and press Play.
Tap a column to drop a disc: it falls to the lowest free hole.
Red always goes first, then Yellow.
Four in a row across, down or diagonally wins. A full board is a draw.
tips: The middle column is part of the most possible fours: start there.
Before you drop, check the hole above your disc: could it hand the other player a win?
Build two threats at once; the other player can only block one.
Drop a disc in the gold ⚡ column to earn a hint coin.
Undo takes back your move and the CPU's reply.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 7 drop in a column, or Left/Right then Enter. Z undoes, N starts a new round. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a column. New Round, Undo and Hint sit under the board.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: a yellow ring shows the column the CPU wants
Ten extra ⚡ coins for hints

hub-connect-four.difficulty: Easy CPU always takes a win but otherwise plays a random column almost half the time; Normal always takes a win, blocks yours and avoids handing you one; Hard searches six moves ahead.

features.rules-screen: The title card lists the three rules; Pause > How to play has them too, and Replay tutorial brings the card back
features.ai-difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard CPU on the title (Hard uses a six-move search)
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back your last move and the CPU's reply; in Pass & Play one move at a time
features.results: Win, lose or draw card with the score, streak and totals; the winning four glow and a line is drawn through them

hub-chess.title: Chess
howto: Pick an opponent (Easy, Medium or Hard bot, or 2 players) and a time control, then press Play.
You are White and move first. Tap a piece to see its moves, then tap a dot (or drag the piece).
Checkmate the black king: attack it so it has no escape.
The rules card (the ? key, or Replay tutorial) explains how every piece moves, castling and en passant.
tips: Control the centre early with pawns and knights.
Castle early to tuck your king away.
Before every move, check what your opponent is attacking.
Hint arrows the engine's move and says why; Undo takes a move back.
The Learn academy has openings, traps, endgames and a quiz.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter or Space picks up and drops a piece, U undoes, R redoes, H hints, F flips, ? opens the rules. P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap or drag pieces; long-press to draw an arrow. The buttons beside the board do the rest.

cheats.effect: Extra queen: a white queen drops onto your side of the board
The bot naps: its next 3 moves are random
Auto hint: the best move is arrowed on every turn

hub-chess.difficulty: Easy bot picks among near-best moves one move deep, Medium searches two moves and Hard three, each with an opening book. Clocks from 1 to 10 minutes or unlimited.

features.rules-screen: The Rules card (goal, how each piece moves, castling, en passant) opens with the ? key, the help button and Pause > Replay tutorial
features.ai-difficulty: Easy, Medium and Hard bots on the start screen, plus bot personalities in the game
features.undo: Undo and Redo buttons (U and R keys)
features.results: Result card (win, loss, draw, resign or time) with moves played, plus Rematch, Share PGN and Review

hub-tic-tac-toe.title: Tic Tac Toe
howto: Pick 2 Players, Easy CPU, Hard CPU or Misère and press Play.
You are X and go first. Tap an empty square.
Three in a row across, down or corner to corner wins; a full board is a draw.
In Misère, making three in a row loses.
tips: The centre sits on four lines: take it when you can.
If the CPU takes the centre, answer with a corner, not an edge.
Two open lines at once (a fork) is the only way to beat anyone who blocks.
Hard CPU plays perfectly, so a draw is a good result.
Hint names the best square and says whether it wins, blocks or keeps lines open.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 9 play a square (or Tab/arrows then Enter), Z undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square. New Round, Undo and Hint sit under the board.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: see the square the CPU wants next (pink outline)
Clean slate: the score board goes back to 0-0

hub-tic-tac-toe.difficulty: Easy CPU picks any square that does not hand you a win; Hard CPU looks ahead through every move and never loses. Misère turns the rules upside down.

features.ai-difficulty: Easy CPU and Hard CPU (perfect play), plus a Misère CPU
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back your move and the CPU's reply; in 2 Players one move at a time
features.results: Win, lose or draw card with the score; the winning line glows and a line is drawn through it

hub-simon-says.title: Simon Says
howto: Choose which round to start at (1, 5 or 10) and press Play.
Watch Simon light up the pads and play their notes.
Repeat the whole sequence by tapping the pads in the same order.
Each round adds one more colour. One wrong tap ends the game.
tips: Say the colours in your head, or hum the notes: sound is easier to remember.
Group long sequences into chunks of three or four.
Replay shows the sequence again once per game.
The flashes speed up every round, so stay focused.
Missed one? Undo that tap once per game, right from the Game Over card.

controls.keyboard: 1 red, 2 green, 3 blue, 4 yellow (or Tab to a pad and Enter). R replays. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the pads. Replay sits above them.

cheats.effect: Slow Simon: flashes last almost twice as long
Show next: the pad to tap next is outlined
Endless replay: replay the sequence as often as you like

hub-simon-says.difficulty: An adaptive curve: every round adds a colour and the flashes get quicker. Starting at round 5 or 10 skips the easy part; Mirror mode (tap the opposite pad) is the expert setting.

features.hints: Replay button shows the sequence again once per game; Pause > Hint names the next colour (and the mirrored pad in Mirror mode)
features.undo: Undo that tap on the Game Over card takes back one wrong tap per game and lets you carry on
features.level-select-or-daily: Start at round 1, 5 or 10 on the title
features.results: Game Over card with the round reached, score, best, pads collected and the correct sequence played back

hub-snake.title: Snake
howto: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard speed and press Play.
The snake waits until your first swipe or arrow key.
Steer to the apples: each one makes you longer and a little faster.
Don't hit the walls, your own tail or the rocks that appear as you grow.
tips: Grab ⭐ gold before it fades: +5, and it blasts a rock away.
A 👻 orb lets you slide through rocks for 5 seconds.
Eat apples quickly one after another to build an eat streak.
Every 5 apples is a new level; the snake speeds up a little with every apple.
When you get long, run along the edges so your tail can't box you in.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD steer; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe on the board to steer

cheats.effect: No walls: the snake wraps round to the other side
Slow snake: 60% speed
Gold rush: a gold star appears after every apple

hub-snake.difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard set the starting speed; on every level the snake gets faster, up to more than twice its starting speed.

features.wave-or-level-counter: LV in the top bar goes up every 5 apples, as the snake speeds up
features.high-score-table: Top 5 scores (with the speed) on the Game Over card; runs with codes on are left out
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, medal, gold, streak, level, rank and the top 5

hub-whack-a-mole.title: Whack-a-Mole
howto: Press Play: a 30-second round starts.
Tap each 🐹 mole as it pops up, before it ducks back down.
⭐ gold moles are worth 5, 👑 crowns 10; a 🎃 boss takes three taps for 25.
Don't tap the 💣: it rumbles before it pops up and costs 3 points.
tips: Five hits in a row without letting one escape raises the multiplier (up to x3).
A hit within 350 ms of a mole popping up earns a +1 speed bonus.
A boss appears every 100 points.
Moles pop up faster and stay up for less time as the clock runs down.
On a keyboard, the number pad layout (7 8 9 / 4 5 6 / 1 2 3) matches the holes.

controls.keyboard: Number keys 1 to 9 whack the matching hole (number-pad layout); Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the moles

cheats.effect: Big hammer: a whack also hits the moles next door
No bombs: only moles pop up
Extra time: rounds last 45 seconds

hub-whack-a-mole.difficulty: An adaptive curve inside each round: moles appear faster and hide sooner as the timer runs down, and bosses arrive every 100 points.

features.instant-restart: Play Again (or Space) on the results card starts a new round
features.best-score-badge: 🏆 best in the top bar next to the score
features.tutorial-card: First-round card with a tapping finger that stays until your first whack
features.results: Time's Up card with score, best, new-best badge and rank

hub-bubble-pop.title: Bubble Pop
howto: Press Play: a 45-second round starts.
Tap bubbles to pop them before they float off the top.
Bigger bubbles score more; ⭐ bubbles split in two, gold bubbles add 4 seconds.
Never tap a 💣: it ends the round at once.
tips: Pop quickly one after another to build a combo: every 4 pops raises the multiplier.
Gold bubbles buy time: +4 seconds each.
Bombs never appear in the first 8 seconds or the last 7.
Bubbles rise faster as the round goes on.
A ⭐ bubble needs two taps: the first splits it.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter on Play; the round is played with the mouse. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the bubbles

cheats.effect: No bombs: only bubbles float up
Slow bubbles: everything rises at 60% speed
Big bubbles: every bubble is a big one

hub-bubble-pop.difficulty: An adaptive curve inside each round: bubbles come more often and rise faster, and bombs become more likely as time runs down.

features.best-score-badge: 🏆 best in the top bar next to the score
features.tutorial-card: First-round card with a tapping finger that stays until your first pop
features.results: Time's Up or Boomed card with score, best, run stats, rank, lifetime pops and badges

hub-merge-blocks.title: Merge Blocks
howto: Pick Easy, Normal, Hard or Daily drops and press Play.
Tap a column (or press 1 to 6) to drop the Next block into it.
Two touching blocks with the same number merge into one twice as big; merges can chain.
The game ends when every column is full.
tips: Keep your biggest numbers along the bottom row.
A drop that sets off a chain scores every merge in it.
Every 8th drop brings a golden 8.
Hint plays every column in a copy of the board and picks the best one.
Undo takes back a drop and every merge it caused.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 6 drop in a column, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a column. Undo and Hint sit in the top bar.

cheats.effect: Undo all: unlimited undos
Big drop: every new block is an 8
Clear top: the top two rows are wiped

hub-merge-blocks.difficulty: Easy gives 3 undos, Normal 1 and Hard none, and on Hard the next block can also be an 8. Daily drops is Normal with the same blocks for everyone today.

features.hints: Hint button (or H, or Pause > Hint): simulates every column with all its merges, highlights the best one and says what it scores
features.undo: Undo button (or Z): 3 on Easy, 1 on Normal and Daily, none on Hard
features.level-select-or-daily: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title, plus Daily drops with the same blocks for everyone each day

hub-word-scramble.title: Word Scramble
howto: Pick a level on the title: 3 letters up to 9+ letters. Harder levels unlock as you earn XP.
Tap the letter tiles in order to spell the hidden word. Tap a filled slot to send a letter back.
Finish each word before the time bar runs out. Three misses or time-outs end the game.
tips: Look for common endings like -ING, -ER and -LE first.
A word with no hints and no mistakes scores a PERFECT +5.
Your streak adds up to +30 points a word, so a skip costs more than it looks.
Shuffle the tiles when you are stuck: a new order often shows the word.
Gold tiles count towards your gold collection on the title screen.

controls.keyboard: Type letters to place tiles, Backspace takes the last one back. Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap tiles to place them, tap a slot to send its letter back

hub-word-scramble.difficulty: Five level bands by word length: 3 letters (ages 5-6), 4-5 (6-7), 6 (7-8), 7-8 (8-9) and 9+ (9 and up). Each band unlocks with XP and gives more time for longer words.

features.tutorial: Guided first word with coach cards (the timer waits); replay with Learn to play

hub-hangman.title: Hangman
howto: Pick a word length (Short, Medium or Long) and a category.
Guess the hidden word one letter at a time: tap the keyboard or type.
Each wrong letter adds a line to the drawing. Seven wrong and the round is lost. Five words make a game.
tips: Start with vowels: A, E, I, O and U are in almost every word.
After the vowels, try common letters like S, T, R and N.
Solve a word with no mistakes to earn a rose token that reveals a letter for free.
Words get longer as the five rounds go on.
Your win streak adds a bonus to every solved word.

controls.touch: Tap the on-screen letters

hub-hangman.difficulty: Three level bands by word length: Short (3-5 letters, ages 6-7), Medium (5-7, ages 8-9) and Long (7+, ages 10 and up). Within a game the words grow longer each round.

hub-missing-letter.title: Missing Letter
howto: Pick a level: Climb starts with 3-letter words and grows, or choose 3, 5 or 6 letters.
One letter is missing from each word. Tap the letter that fills the gap.
Score as many words as you can in 60 seconds. Endless mode has no clock but only 3 hearts.
tips: Say the word out loud: the missing sound often jumps out.
Wait 3 seconds and a picture clue appears above the word.
Answer within 2 seconds for a +5 slipstream bonus.
Every 4 right in a row raises your score multiplier.
A wrong answer costs 2 seconds, so a quick guess is not always best.

hub-spell-and-say.title: Spell & Say
howto: Pick a level and press Play. The game says a word out loud.
Spell it with the letter keys, then tap the tick to check.
Three wrong spellings end the game. Spell 8 in a row to win a heart back.
tips: Tap the turtle to hear the word extra slowly and listen for each sound.
The light bulb shows the next letter once per word, for 5 points.
Words you miss go on your Tricky list. Spell them right later to clear them.
Spelling a word within about 4 seconds earns a +3 fast bonus.
No voice on this device? The word flashes on screen for a moment instead.

A word appears. Type a word that rhymes with it and tap DROP or press Enter.
Answer before the time bar empties. Three misses and the mic drops.

Pass skips a hard word without losing a heart, but it breaks your chain.

hub-math-blast.title: Math Blast

Pop the ice bubble to freeze every bubble for 3 seconds.

howto: Choose which sums to practise (+, -, × and ÷) and a level, then press Start.
Work out the sum at the top and steer the snake onto the number with the answer.
A wrong number or a wall costs a heart. You have three.
tips: Pick the wrong number twice and the right one starts to glow.
Four right answers in a row start a Frenzy: extra points for 10 seconds.
Every 5 in a row wins back a heart.

bridge-race-classic.title: Bridge Race

Reach the finish flag to win. Tap, click or Space jumps.

claire-pip.title: Claire's Big Life

Do Tricks, play Games (Star Catch, Paw Match, Homework, Bible Quiz, Memory Verse) and grow the Garden to earn stars.

sneaker-drop.title: SneakerDrop — Hype Market Tycoon
howto: Each day, check the hype calendar: a coloured dot is a sneaker drop.
Tap SNIPE, then tap again when the needle is in the gold zone to buy the pair at retail.
Tap a pair in storage and flip it into a live auction. Press SELL NOW when the top bid beats what you paid.
Hit NEXT DAY to move on. After ten weeks the run closes; your score is profit per week.
tips: A GRAIL drop is worth sniping even at a high retail price: it resells for almost double.
Late auction bids can retract. A good bid at FINAL CALL is safer than waiting for the hammer.
Grading adds up to 50% to the sale price, so grade your best pairs before you flip them.
Three good snipes in a row widen the timing window.
CASH OUT RUN locks in your profit per week early: a strong week can beat a long grind.

deepcut-mine.title: DEEPCUT
howto: Hold down to drill into the rock below your rig.
Dig into coloured ore to load it into your cargo hold.
Climb back to the surface: the load sells itself, and the tank and hull refill.
Spend cash in the surface shop on a faster drill, a bigger hold, more fuel and armour, then dig deeper.
tips: Fuel burns faster while you drill; turn back when the gold bar drops below a third.
Ore dug in a quick streak is worth up to 60% more: keep the STREAK counter going.
Lava first shows up in the Granite below 120 m and gets far more common deeper down. A Radiator from the shop cuts its burn.
Out of fuel you can still crawl, but the strain eats your hull. Climb, do not dig.
A wreck keeps your cash and upgrades; it only costs half the cargo you were carrying.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to drill and move. Enter or Space starts from the title. P or Esc pauses.

cheats.effect: Fuel never runs out
The hull takes no damage
The lamp lights the whole mine

cook-rush.title: Cook Rush

Spend coins on permanent kitchen upgrades between shifts.

Food left on the pan burns and the ticket starts over: take it off as soon as COOK dings.

Every serve in a row raises the combo multiplier; a mistake or a walk-out resets it.
Hot Pans give a longer burn window; Comfy Seats make customers wait longer.

typhoon-mine.title: TYPHOON MINE
howto: Hold down to tunnel into the mountain and break ore into your hold.

Falling debris stops at the first solid rock: when the wind builds, tunnel sideways under cover.
Roof supports soften debris and lightning hits and give you a little more warning.
Being carried out keeps your bank and upgrades; you only lose half of the ore you were holding.

snap-jigsaw.title: Snap Jigsaw — Daily Puzzle Challenge
howto: Each level is a picture cut into squares. The faint picture on the board shows where every piece belongs.
Drag a piece from the tray onto its spot. A right piece locks in green and builds a combo.
A wrong piece sits in its cell with an orange edge until you drag it somewhere else.
Fill the board. Fewer moves earn more stars; clearing a level unlocks the next.
tips: Start with the corners and edges: they are the easiest to match to the faint picture.
Look for the sun, clouds and hill lines: they run across several pieces.
HINT lights up a piece and its spot, or points out a piece that is in the wrong cell.
UNDO takes back your last move, including a swap.
The Daily Puzzle is a new picture every day: clear it each day to grow your streak.
Leave whenever you like: the puzzle in progress is kept, and PLAY turns into CONTINUE.

kingdom-defense.title: Kingdom Defense
howto: Press PLAY NOW, then pick a difficulty and a map.

Tap a placed defender to buy one of its three upgrade paths, or to sell it.

godot-tidebreak.title: TIDEBREAK
howto: Pick a stop on the World Tour and press START EVENT to surf its heat.

Tap Space near the lip to launch, then spin (A/D) and flip (W) in the air; hold Q to rotate faster.
Land straight to score the trick and grow your COMBO before the heat clock runs out.
tips: Link tricks quickly: the combo multiplier climbs to 8x and drops back when you stop.
A crooked landing is a wipeout: it costs 250 points and resets the combo.
Rocks and hazards in the water knock you off; carve around them.
Coins along the wave add to your score.
Bronze or better at a stop unlocks the next one on the tour.
